svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The build
svg.desc: The 38 installation steps in eight phases and three lanes: human only, Claude drives while the human authenticates, and Claude alone. Phase 1 is the one command the installer runs for you — steps 10 to 13, the four you would otherwise type by hand. The handover at step 14 is the pivot. 15 steps are repeated when rebuilding a machine.
svg.text: Before the handover you open accounts and paste one command — or type the four by hand. After it, you log in, grant and decide — nothing else.
Filled steps are what a second machine repeats: 15 of 38.
